about.title: Tantana Hotel in Fergana
about.subtitle: A modern hotel in the centre of Fergana for travellers who value comfort, calm and genuine hospitality.

story.title: Uzbek hospitality, at your pace
paragraphs: Tantana Hotel welcomes guests on Al-Fargani Street in Fergana — a city known as the gateway to the Fergana Valley, its silk workshops, ceramic masters and green orchards.

Whether you are visiting for business, a family celebration or to explore the region, the hotel offers a calm base with a restaurant, a conference hall and a reception team that is available around the clock.

about.missingNote: The hotel's history, team and official photos will be added once provided by the hotel.

discover.title: Discover Fergana
discover.subtitle: Silk workshops, ceramic traditions, historic palaces and mountain air — the valley rewards curious travellers.
discover.note: Photos are illustrative. Distances, opening hours and travel times aren't listed here — please check them before you travel or ask the reception team.

margilan.name: Margilan & the Yodgorlik Silk Factory
margilan.text: Margilan is famous for its silk. At the Yodgorlik factory you can see how traditional atlas and adras fabrics are made by hand.

rishtan.name: Rishtan ceramics
rishtan.text: Rishtan has been a centre of ceramics for centuries, known for its deep blue and turquoise glazes. Visit a master's workshop and see the craft up close.

kokand.name: Khudoyar Khan Palace
kokand.text: The 19th-century palace of the last ruler of the Kokand Khanate, with richly decorated facades and courtyards.

ferganaPark.name: Al-Fargani Park
ferganaPark.text: A large green park in the city named after the medieval astronomer Al-Fargani — a pleasant place for an evening walk.
ferganaPark.alt: A green park with tall trees

kumtepa.name: Kumtepa Bazaar
kumtepa.text: A traditional market where you can find textiles, local produce and everyday life of the valley.

museum.name: Fergana Regional Museum
museum.text: The regional museum of local lore introduces the history, nature and culture of the Fergana Valley.

shohimardon.name: Shohimardon
shohimardon.text: A mountain area known for its fresh air and the Kokkul lake. Please check current travel requirements before planning a trip.
